subject: Taxes
title: Tax Avoidance vs. Tax Evasion
description: One-minute skill: Tax Avoidance vs. Tax Evasion.

hook.text: Tax avoidance is legal—using deductions and credits to reduce what you owe.

buildup.text: Avoidance: contributing to a 401(k), claiming the mortgage deduction, donating to charity.

discovery.text: Evasion: hiding cash income, using fake deductions, or stashing money in unreported offshore accounts. These are crimes.

twist.text: Aggressive 'tax shelters' blur the line. Some arrangements are legal but exploit loopholes Congress never intended.

climax.text: The difference between avoidance and evasion is often just the quality of your lawyer. Wealth buys better tax planning.

punchline.text: Legal vs. illegal. The line blurs with a good enough accountant.

quiz.question: What is the key difference between tax avoidance and tax evasion?
options: Avoidance is legal; evasion is illegal
